prompts.vivi: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production character turnaround sheet for VIVI (비비), the dragon girl from Trickcal Revive, based faithfully on the character in the supplied reference screenshot and portrait. Ignore all webpage UI. Three full body orthographic views on one wide canvas: FRONT, LEFT SIDE, BACK, equal scale, feet on same baseline, neutral relaxed A pose, arms slightly apart, no perspective, no action. Preserve original short chibi proportions (about 2.3 heads tall), round cheeks, very long flowing silver-white hair with dark roots, two dark swept-back horns, long pointed ears, red-orange eyes, red diamond earrings, white petal-shaped outer gown over dark burgundy ruffled dress, black neck bow, dark boots. Separate small dark metallic dragon wing/blade ornaments at back; do not hide the body. Match clothing layers seen in reference; infer a coherent back and side, not an official design claim. Clean readable colored concept art with precise outlines and simple neutral shading, pale warm gray background, generous margins. Top title 'VIVI / FAN GAME MODEL GUIDE'. Only labels FRONT, LEFT SIDE, BACK underneath, small footer 'Side and back are interpreted'. No extra characters, no extra costumes, no sexualization, no cropped head or feet. This sheet will guide a Blender low-poly chibi model; clarity and cross-view consistency are paramount.
prompts.aya: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a matching full-body model reference for Aya from Trickcal using the supplied corrected FRONT as the exact identity and style reference. She has TWO WHITE ANKLE-LENGTH LOW TWIN TAILS, tied separately on either side below the ears by pale blue butterfly ties. Keep the full tail length from each tie down to ankle level, with thick flowing tapered hair, subtle cool gray strand lines and curled tips. Hair must stay distinct from sleeves, patterned kimono, skirt and the flower parasol. Keep warm brown skin, gold eyes, swept long bangs hiding one eye, black forehead patch, dark obi with flower clasp, white gray-wave-patterned kimono and gold trim, sandals, blue gem earring. Keep the same separate OPEN WHITE FLOWER-PETAL PARASOL with blue-gray underside, ribs, shaft and grip in her ANATOMICAL RIGHT HAND (viewer-left in supplied front). Preserve this handedness when rotating; do not mirror character. Exact same chibi proportions, clean cel-shaded illustration and line art. Whole canopy, hair tips and feet must be uncropped with margins. The two long tails are hair, not extra garment panels. No text, no scene, no pedestal. Draw a WIDE LANDSCAPE THREE-VIEW character turnaround sheet: FRONT, LEFT PROFILE facing left, BACK. Exactly three full characters aligned to the same baseline and scale with ample spacing between complete parasols. All three depict exactly the same ANKLE-LENGTH TWIN TAILS and identical outfit/parasol. Rear view has two long distinct tails and a gap showing the obi. Front must closely match supplied image. Plain pale warm-gray background, no text or captions. This is a fan-model interpretation of unseen side/rear details.
prompts.id: Precise costume edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET; image 2 is the APPROVED CORRECTED COSTUME. In image 1 replace Ed's tracksuit with the EXACT outfit in image 2: fitted sleeveless one-piece white/black bodysuit with white central torso and black sides, small white neck band and thin crossed black halter straps, bare arms and simple white wrist bands, dark charcoal thigh-high stockings with narrow white side piping, a small natural gap above stocking tops, and white low ankle shoes. Remove jacket, zipper, baggy sleeves, cuffs, elastic waist and loose trousers completely. Maintain the target's small chibi body proportions and neutral sleepy seated pose without anatomical emphasis. Preserve EVERYTHING ELSE: long white hair, closed eyes when visible, elf ears, pose, camera direction, complete crescent pod, floating robot, illustration style, colors and layout. DO NOT add another character or another view. Do not change view direction, pod geometry or robot direction. No text. Keep EXACTLY the existing THREE-VIEW sheet (front, left profile, rear), and its pale background. Correct costume wherever visible in all three views. The rear robot remains featureless.
prompts.picora: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production character turnaround sheet with corrected shoulder bag. Image 1 is the corrected Picora body, preserve this identity, palette, chibi scale, head silhouette and costume. Image 2 is the original design showing HOW the shoulder bag is worn. Image 3 is the isolated bag design; ignore its background haze. The small cream oval bag with pink curved front graphic, white wing/scallop upper trim, pink bow and double-cherry lower strap charm is on the character's anatomical LEFT hip (viewer RIGHT in a frontal view). A SINGLE narrow white strap passes over the SAME LEFT shoulder, straight down the side/front edge of the vest and behind the same arm to connect to the bag. It is a SAME-SIDE SHOULDER BAG, not crossbody; no diagonal across the chest, no backpack straps. The bag is small, approximately one quarter to one third the width of her head; it rests beside the skirt, not at knee height. Keep the cherries on the BAG strap only. Keep teal-white plaid skirt, pink vest/heart/bow, white sleeves, candy twin buns and curled side hair with ornaments, aqua-pink eyes, cheek heart, closed relaxed mouth, mismatched stockings/boots and white wing with teal bow on the striped-side boot. Original attached art has hand and hair occlusion; infer only enough hidden connections for a coherent 3D guide. Create ONE wide clean three-view sheet: FRONT, LEFT SIDE, BACK in that order. Orthographic full-body views at identical scale and aligned baseline, neutral relaxed A-pose, empty hands. Left side means a view of the character's anatomical LEFT side, the BAG SIDE; nose points to the LEFT of the page in this side view. Preserve the same costume and worn bag in all views. In the BACK view the bag must appear on page-LEFT, because it remains on anatomical left; show the back portion of its white same-shoulder strap, not an X or diagonal harness. Keep shoulder strap passing underneath hair where naturally occluded. The unobserved back of bag is plain cream with dusty-pink gusset, a minimal inferred construction, no invented front swirl on the back. Long loop of strap lies against the shoulder/body when worn, it must not arch above the head. No separate staff/weapon panel. Pale warm neutral solid background, crisp colored line art and restrained flat cel shading, no glow or shadows. Small exact title 'PICORA / SHOULDER BAG'. Exact view labels 'FRONT', 'LEFT SIDE', 'BACK'. Small exact footer 'Side and back are interpreted.' Spacious balanced layout, do not crop limbs or hair. This is a fan-game reference, not an official model sheet.
